mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS >4.5% for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and declines in unemployment rate indicate overheating economy with tightening policy, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts above 1200 thousand units signal strong consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during housing recovery phases.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods with HOUST >1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in unemployment rate over 3 months indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of periods with 3-month UNRATE decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market overheating that may trigger aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of periods with UNRATE <4.0% for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production over 3 months indicates robust supply chain conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of periods with 3-month INDPRO rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals late-cycle expansion where policy tightening risks outweigh growth momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of periods with GDPC1 >2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
